title: Where the storks go: four migratory birds on one hand-inked map
excerpt: I followed 228 tagged birds across three continents. Young storks flew 0.6% of their distance over the sea and squeezed through Gibraltar and the Bosporus; ospreys and cuckoos cross the open sea without a second thought.
seo_description: Storks, ospreys, cuckoos and marsh harriers tracked by satellite across three continents: routes, funnels, sea crossings, winter quarters and fates.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where the storks go' in black and red hand lettering on parchment, beside a hand-inked map of Europe and Africa with the red tracks of young white storks funnelling through Gibraltar and the Levant to the Sahel, and pen-drawn storks flying along them. Text: 228 tagged birds of four species; storks flew 0.6% of their distance over water, ospreys 22%.
